title: Three ships attacked in Strait of Hormuz as Iran 'weaponises' passage point
summary: The U.S.-Israeli war on Iran has ⁠threatened Gulf ports ​and disrupted global trade through the Strait of Hormuz through which roughly a fifth of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas ​normally passes. Iran tells the world to prepare for $200 oil barrels, as three more ships came under attack in the blockaded Gulf.
